item.title: Bondholders sue Triple Five affiliate and NJ municipality, claiming collusion to cut megamall’s PILOT payments
item.description: Alleged collusion by Triple Five’s American Dream megamall and New Jersey town puts repayment of $800 million in bonds at risk: lawsuit claims.

item.title: Walmart to open supercenter at its current Riverhead location
item.description: Walmart plans to convert its Riverhead store into a 180,000-square-foot supercenter with a full-service supermarket and a discount department store.

item.title: Police investigate head-on crash involving school bus, SUV in Calverton Monday afternoon
item.description: A head-on crash between a mini school bus and an SUV in Calverton yesterday afternoon sent seven people to the hospital, including two children. All injuries were not life-threatening, police said.

item.title: Crime Stoppers: Woman sought in Marshalls theft in Riverhead
item.description: Suffolk County Crime Stoppers and Riverhead Town police are seeking the public’s help to identify a woman accused of stealing about $560 in merchandise from Marshalls on Old Country Road on Dec. 11.

item.title: John H. (Jack) Kratoville, 93
item.description: John H. Kratoville of Riverhead died Feb. 6, 2026. He was 93 years old.

item.title: Riverhead chef Jerry Dicecco hosts middle school French club culinary field trip
item.description: Chef Jerry Dicecco hosted the Riverhead Middle School French Club for a culinary field trip, serving up frog legs, escargot, moules-frites and crème brûlée to 8th graders.

item.title: Woman found dead in wooded area in Manorville; Suffolk homicide detectives investigating
item.description: Suffolk County Police are investigating the death of a woman whose body was found in a wooded area in Manorville Wednesday.

item.title: Abe Lincoln: A president whose morality, statesmanship and tenacity truly made America great
item.description: On Lincoln's birthday, a reflection on the life and legacy of the 16th president. Column by Greg Blass

item.title: America and the Black Vote: AAECF forum
item.description: A nonpartisan forum marking Black History Month will examine the historical legacy and contemporary impact of the Black vote on American democracy.

item.title: Riverhead woman facing murder charge in 32-year-old cold case
item.description: A Riverhead woman is facing a murder charge in a cold case dating back to September 1993, according to Suffolk County criminal court filings.
